FAQ.actualizar: Can I upgrade or downgrade my current plan?
FAQ.actualizartexto:
Yes, you have the flexibility to upgrade or downgrade your current plan on ContiA. We understand that your needs and requirements may change over time, and we want to adapt to those changes.

If you find that your current plan no longer fits what you need and you require additional features or resources, you can upgrade your plan. To do this, go to the 'Manage subscriptions' tab and choose the plan you want; follow the indicated steps or, if you prefer, contact us at contia@contia.io. This usually involves accessing higher-tier plans that offer more functionalities, increased limits, or additional benefits.

The process to upgrade your plan is usually straightforward and you can do it directly from your account settings or by contacting our support team.

Similarly, if you feel that you no longer need certain features or want to adjust your subscription to better fit your needs, you can downgrade your plan. This allows you to switch to a lower-tier plan that still includes the essential features you need, but at a lower cost or with fewer resources.

Just like with the upgrade, downgrading the plan can also be done from your account settings or by contacting our customer service team.

At ContiA, we strive to make the process of changing plans—whether it's an upgrade or a downgrade—as smooth as possible, ensuring that you have the necessary flexibility to adjust your subscription according to your changing needs. Our support team is available to assist you at any time, answer your questions, and guide you to make the best decision.
FAQ.cancelartexto:
Yes, you can cancel your plan at any time.

At ContiA, we understand that circumstances and preferences can change, and we want to offer flexibility to our users. We believe in providing a hassle-free experience, which includes the ability to cancel your subscription or plan whenever you need to.

When you decide to cancel your plan, you can usually do so from the “Manage Subscriptions” tab or by contacting our support team at contia@contia.io. We strive to make the cancellation process clear and straightforward, ensuring that you have complete control over your subscription.

It is important to note that cancellation terms may vary depending on the type of subscription or plan you have chosen. Some plans may have a minimum commitment period or fees associated with cancellation. However, even with these conditions, our goal is to keep the process as smooth and transparent as possible.

At ContiA, we value our users and want to ensure that they are satisfied with our services. While we would regret seeing you go, we respect your decision and are committed to providing you with a positive experience both during your subscription and in the cancellation process.

If you have any additional questions or need assistance in canceling your plan, our customer service team is available to guide you and address any concerns you may have.
FAQ.opcionestexto:
At ContiA, we offer a variety of convenient payment options to ensure a smooth and hassle-free shopping experience.

The following payment methods are available:

Payment by link: Our platform allows you to make payments through a secure link provided during the checkout process. This method lets you authorize the payment directly from your bank account, ensuring fast and efficient transactions.

Credit card: We accept all major credit cards, giving you the flexibility to pay with your preferred card. Our payment system is encrypted and completely secure, protecting your personal and financial information.

Debit card: You can also pay with your debit card. You just need to enter your card details during the checkout process, and the payment will be processed securely. Make sure your card is enabled for online transactions.

At ContiA, we prioritize the security of your payment information and follow industry best practices to protect your privacy. Our payment systems use encryption and comply with strict security standards to safeguard your sensitive data.

If you encounter any issues or have specific questions related to payments, our customer service team is available to assist you quickly at contia@contia.io.

We strive to provide you with a professional, reliable, and satisfactory payment experience at all times.

Please note that the availability of certain payment methods may vary depending on your location and the type of service you are purchasing. We recommend checking the payment page for the most up-to-date information on available methods.

Thank you for choosing ContiA. We are delighted to serve you and provide you with a seamless payment experience.
